detail: Add a bounded P4 member-read + CAPTURED-receipt accessor as a new ADR/correction to ADR-0127 Decision.2: after authorize_capture_set, the returned CapturedAuthorizationRecord exposes a one-way session-bound read of a captured publication's retained member bytes and a read-only CAPTURED receipt digest per capture.
effect: Authorizes drafting ADR-0129 (bounded P4 member-read + receipt accessor), which requires its own owner approval before RED. No trust.py change is authorized until ADR-0129 is approved.
